name: Dominica Government Primary Data Center and Backup Site
developer: Government of the Commonwealth of Dominica / Digicel Dominica
notes: CARDTP official project page says the government connectivity project includes a primary data center to host government cloud/applications plus a secondary backup location. Dominica News Online reported the 2019 Government-Digicel 15-year telecoms contract would connect government sites to a resilient fiber network backed by two on-island and one off-island data centre. Exact facility sites and capacity were not disclosed; assigned to Saint George because government ICT/project offices and the 2019 signing locus are in the Roseau/Goodwill area, but the project serves government sites islandwide.
